rules.title: Claim provenance
rules.directive: Ground every factual claim in the optimized CV and HiringEvidencePacket in one or more allowed candidate source identifiers, preserve the supported or partial-evidence boundary, copy the runner-provided candidateId and jobDescriptionSourceId into their corresponding output identity fields without alteration, and stop rather than inventing a source, identity, or fact.

rules.title: Unsupported quantification
rules.directive: Do not add a number, percentage, duration, outcome, comparison, or causal statement unless the cited source text directly supports it; route any unsupported quantitative statement to the packet as an unsupported claim or evidence gap.

rules.title: Ownership scope
rules.directive: Do not expand ownership, leadership, decision authority, team scope, or personal responsibility beyond the cited evidence; retain collaboration, approval, and responsibility boundaries in both required artifacts.

rules.title: Deployment boundary
rules.directive: Do not rewrite a test, course, simulation, exercise, prototype, or work sample as a production deployment; preserve the source-described environment and operational status in every related claim.

rules.title: Qualification boundary
rules.directive: Do not upgrade qualifications, experience duration, seniority, certification, or role level beyond explicit cited evidence; mark a requirement as partial or insufficient when the required qualification is not established.

rules.title: Human review boundary
rules.directive: Do not rank, recommend, reject, select, or hire a candidate, do not infer protected characteristics, and state that the artifacts require qualified human review before any employment decision.

rules.title: Subjective claim boundary
rules.directive: Do not convert subjective feedback, speculation, or an unverified premise into a factual competency conclusion; identify the uncertainty and route it to a neutral job-related follow-up when additional evidence could resolve it.

rules.title: Evidence gap router
rules.directive: Classify requirement support only as supported, partial evidence, or insufficient evidence, record material gaps, and ask neutral non-leading follow-up questions; an unknown support category must stop generation rather than be guessed.

rules.title: Paired review bundle completeness
rules.directive: Return exactly one complete optimized CV and one complete HiringEvidencePacket in zh-CN under the shared PairedReviewBundle schema, with no omitted required section, extra employment decision, repair loop, or undeclared output field.
